subject: 定州贡院 · 魁阁号舍完整正立面
caption: 魁阁号舍
中央魁阁与两侧号舍七组屋顶的正面组合
source_note: 拟用现存魁阁号舍所呈清代扩建形制；独栋精确创建年需在照片阶段进一步核定。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: Kuige and examination cubicles of the Dingzhou Examination Hall, Hebei, Qing dynasty. Landscape 1536x1024, full building width about 82% canvas leaving generous margins. This is a distinctive symmetric SEVEN-BAY building with SEVEN adjoining front roof units arranged like steps or a mountain: one highest projecting central two-storey Kuixing pavilion roof, THREE successive progressively lower roof units to its LEFT, and THREE matching lower roof units to its RIGHT. The seven front roof crests must all be present, do not convert it into one long ordinary hall or a pagoda. Follow exact photo geometry: center has a tall open upper balcony and plain balustrade, ground-level middle doorway and shallow central stair; flanking sections have timber posts and lattice doors/windows. Uppermost center roof is a small pyramidal/pavilion form; flanking roofs have ridge and gable geometry following photo. Retain the tiny permanent Kuixing statue in the upper central balcony as sparse, unobtrusive contours (it is not a tourist); no dark fills. Building surfaces are mainly white, lattice suggested with few fine strokes. Remove garden trees, all freestanding notices, plaques and painted calligraphy, grass and distant high-rises. Copy the low narrow platform, not a grand temple terrace. All seven roof-unit silhouettes and ground corners must remain complete.

site_recommendation.name: 定州贡院
site_recommendation.yearNote: 拟用现存魁阁号舍所呈清代扩建形制；独栋精确创建年需在照片阶段进一步核定。
site_recommendation.lede: 七组屋顶如山势层层升起，中央魁阁与两侧号舍连为一体，留下清代地方科举的建筑记忆。

facts.label: 科举
facts.text: 贡院始建于乾隆三年（1738），道光十四年（1834）扩建，现有规模主要由此次扩建形成。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 图绘魁阁号舍正面：中央魁阁高起，两侧号舍逐次降低，七组屋顶构成鲜明的对称轮廓。

facts.label: 遗存
facts.text: 院内保留号舍、魁阁与揽胜楼等建筑，属于少见的清代地方科举考场遗存。

quality_check.notes: 输入输出已查看，七组屋顶完整，中心魁星小像保留；外侧檐角与台基未裁切。
